slides.title: Introduction to NumPy
slides.content:
# NumPy 🔢

The foundation of Python data science!

## Installation

```bash
pip install numpy
```

## Why NumPy?
- ⚡ 50x faster than lists
- 📊 N-dimensional arrays
- 🧮 Mathematical operations
- 🔗 Base for Pandas, TensorFlow

```python
import numpy as np
```

> 💡 **NumPy powers nearly all data science in Python!**

slides.title: Array Creation
slides.content:
# Creating Arrays 📊

```python
import numpy as np

# From list
arr = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])

# Zeros and ones
zeros = np.zeros((3, 4))
ones = np.ones((2, 3))

# Range
arr = np.arange(0, 10, 2)  # [0, 2, 4, 6, 8]
space = np.linspace(0, 1, 5)  # 5 evenly spaced

# Random
rand = np.random.rand(3, 3)  # 0-1
randint = np.random.randint(0, 10, (3, 3))
```

## Array Properties

```python
arr.shape    # (3, 4)
arr.dtype    # int64
arr.ndim     # 2
arr.size     # 12
```

slides.title: Array Operations
slides.content:
# Operations ⚡

## Vectorized Operations

```python
arr = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])

arr + 10      # [11, 12, 13, 14, 15]
arr * 2       # [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
arr ** 2      # [1, 4, 9, 16, 25]
np.sqrt(arr)  # Square roots
```

## Aggregations

```python
arr.sum()      # Total
arr.mean()     # Average
arr.std()      # Standard deviation
arr.min()      # Minimum
arr.max()      # Maximum
arr.argmax()   # Index of max
```

## Reshaping

```python
arr = np.arange(12)
arr.reshape(3, 4)   # 3x4 matrix
arr.reshape(-1, 1)  # Column vector
arr.flatten()       # Back to 1D
```
